personality_one_liner: A modern, photo-first local city platform that feels native, premium, and warmly rooted in Mediterranean aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Use iOS-native rhythms with generous padding around content. Avoid tight dashboard layouts; empty space is intentional breathing room.

do_s: Apply to bottom tab bar and sticky top headers when content scrolls behind them.
Use for floating action buttons (FAB) over a brandTertiary tinted bg.
Use as an overlay for the weather widget on the home screen hero.
dont_s: Never apply to form fields or body text regions.
Do not use on regular list rows or basic cards.

screens.name: Ana Sayfa (Home)
screens.purpose: A dashboard for city life, providing quick access to weather, top categories, and featured local highlights.

states.empty: Illustration of the city with a welcome message
states.error: Message 'Hava durumu veya içerikler yüklenemedi' with Retry button

screens.layout: Top area: Location header ('Seydişehir') and a large hero Weather Card (landscape photo with glassmorphism overlay). Below: Quick action chips (pill-shaped) for high-traffic items like 'Nöbetçi Eczane'. Followed by a horizontaly scrolling 'Öne Çıkanlar' (Featured News/Events) using large rounded cards. Finally, a 4x2 icon grid for core 'Kategoriler' (using brandTertiary tinted icon containers).

screens.name: Firmalar (Business Directory)
screens.purpose: A categorized directory of local businesses allowing users to easily find, contact, and locate services.

states.empty: Storefront icon + 'Henüz bu kategoride firma yok' + primary CTA to add business

screens.layout: Sticky top category filter tabs (glassmorphism if scrolling under). Vertical list of business cards. Each card spans full width (minus padding), containing a thumbnail image (left), title, category, and a quick 'Ara' (Call) button.

screens.name: Akış (Social Feed)
screens.purpose: Instagram-like vertical social feed for user-generated content, news, and community updates.

states.empty: Camera icon + 'Henüz gönderi yok, ilk paylaşan siz olun' + 'Gönderi Oluştur' CTA

screens.layout: Top: horizontally scrolling 'Hikayeler' (Stories) row with circular avatars and brandPrimary borders. Below: Vertical feed of posts. Each post has a header (avatar + username), a full-width edge-to-edge image, action bar (like, comment icons), and minimal text description. Minimal white background between posts.

screens.name: Keşfet (Discover)
screens.purpose: A visually engaging masonry or tiled grid exploring popular classifieds (İlanlar), places, and community content.

states.empty: Magnifying glass icon + 'Keşfedilecek yeni bir şey bulunamadı'

screens.layout: Search bar at the top (surfaceTertiary background). Below, a 2-column grid of varying height cards (masonry feel) showing classifieds items, top events, and recommended user posts.

screens.name: Profil (Profile)
screens.purpose: User identity hub showing their posts, followers, and account settings.

states.empty: Not applicable for profile header, but empty state for posts: 'Henüz fotoğraf paylaşmadınız'

screens.layout: Top profile header with a cover image (using gradient-to-dark scrim if text overlaps) and circular avatar overlapping the bottom edge. Follower/Following metrics. Tabbed view below for 'Gönderiler' (Grid of user's photos) and 'Kaydedilenler' (Saved items). Settings gear icon in the top right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the iOS-Native Clean aesthetic (Personality 1): Use generous padding, readable Geist typography, and avoid dense dashboard-style clutter.
BANNED COLORS: Do not use any shades of Blue, Indigo, Violet, or Purple. Stick to the provided warm Terracotta (#C35235) primary theme to evoke a local Mediterranean/Turkish feel.

MANDATORY SCRIM: Anytime text is placed over an image (e.g., the Home Weather hero card or event cards), apply a vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to ensure WCAG AAA readability.
For the 16 app categories, do not use bare icons. Place each icon inside a rounded square container tinted with `brandTertiary`, maintaining a premium and organized look.

Implement an Instagram-style layout for the 'Akış' (Social Feed): utilize full-width imagery for posts, keep metadata compact below the image, and use a minimal white background to let user content shine.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt across the app, especially for interaction icons like the 'Like' and 'Comment' buttons on the feed.
Add subtle haptic feedback for primary actions such as liking a post or switching bottom tabs.
